policy: Any article directly associated with an evaluation benchmark is protected from inclusion in the primary ElderDocAI-GeriLit corpus used for that benchmark.
note: Benchmark datasets are NOT downloaded in this task. No PMID/PMCID identifiers are invented. Entries below with status PENDING_BENCHMARK_ACQUISITION carry empty id lists and document the planned source.

benchmarks.planned_source: qiaojin/PubMedQA (pqa_labeled/test) on Hugging Face; official PubMedQA project
benchmarks.acquisition_note: Populate protected_ids with the pqa_labeled test PMIDs after acquisition; exclude those articles from GeriLit and evaluate against the benchmark's own abstracts.

benchmarks.planned_source: TREC 2014-2016 Clinical Decision Support track (NIST) - judged PMCIDs/PMC OA subset documents
benchmarks.acquisition_note: Populate protected_ids with judged PMCIDs after NIST material is obtained.

benchmarks.planned_source: BioASQ Task 11b golden sets (bioasq.org registration) - golden document PMIDs/PMCIDs
benchmarks.acquisition_note: Populate protected_ids with golden-document PMIDs/PMCIDs when officially available and documented.

gold96_sources.description: Gold96 (data/gold_qa_extended.json) source documents are the original ElderDocAI six-PDF knowledge base (NIA/NIH/WHO/USDA materials). These are NOT PMC articles; a provenance + future overlap-check mechanism is defined here.
gold96_sources.overlap_check_mechanism: Before final-corpus freeze, 13-gram containment + MinHash/Jaccard scans of Gold96 question/answer text and supporting spans against all GeriLit chunks; document results.

gold96_v2.note: Future Gold96-v2 (GeriLit-grounded) must attach a protected-source mechanism: its anchor PMCID/PMID/section/chunk list will be written here before it is evaluated.
